description: The project owner's drop chance table (decision D3-11, docs/ITERATION_LOG.md), applied by the drop runtime (scripts/core/drops/drop_rates.gd DropRates, drop_roller.gd DropRoller) to the canonical drop records (data/canonical/drops/<owner id>.json, schema 3, contract C1 in docs/runtime/ITERATION_THREE_CONTRACTS.md). A record lists who can drop what (MeowDB's community list 'Drops (MS Classic)'), each member's rarity (Henesys.gg's label) and its chance_category; the chance of a member is chance_table[chance_category][rarity], a probability in [0, 1] (1.0 = always, 0.001 = 0.1%). The same table applies to monsters and the Wooden Box. Edit any cell to tune a drop: DropChecks requires every category x rarity cell, each a number in [0, 1]. The ground rules (lifetime, ownership, scatter) are data/misostory/drops.json; mesos are data/misostory/meso_rules.json (decision D3-12).
reason: MeowDB MS Classic publishes no drop chances and Henesys.gg publishes only a rarity label per item, so the project owner approved this table on 2026-10-06 as a MisoStory adaptation (decision D3-11): a chance per item category and rarity. It is not a MapleStory fact and is not verified against anything.

category_rules.etc_own_leftover: Etc item whose MeowDB subtype is 'Monster Drop' (the monster's own leftover: Snail Shell, Mushroom Spore, Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece)
category_rules.etc_quest_gated: Etc item whose MeowDB subtype is 'Quest Item' and that a Maple Island quest objective asks for (the quest-gate rule, quest_gate_rule below): it drops only while that quest is in progress
category_rules.etc_other: any other Etc item (ores, gems, Monster Card, a quest item no Maple Island quest asks for)
category_rules.use_consumable: Use item whose MeowDB subtype is not 'Scroll' (potions, food, arrows)
category_rules.use_scroll: Use item whose MeowDB subtype is 'Scroll'

quantity_per_drop_reason: No source gives a drop quantity; the owner's table drops one item per successful roll (decision D3-11).

quest_gate_rule.value: an entry is gated to a quest only when its item's MeowDB subtype is 'Quest Item' AND a Maple Island quest objective asks for it; it rolls only while that quest is in progress, and without a roll context it never rolls
quest_gate_rule.reason: MeowDB does not say who can loot a quest item. The orchestrator's derivation (contract C1) is applied by tools/sources/drops_merge.mjs, which writes each gate into the record's quest_gate with its basis: Old Wooden Board and Rusty Screw are gated to Pio's quest 1012; Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece (MeowDB subtype Monster Drop) is not.

chance_table.decision: D3-11 (docs/ITERATION_LOG.md): the drop chance table by item category x Henesys.gg rarity, approved 2026-10-06
